text.tspan: MuZero and TD-MPC2: predicting what a search procedure needs
MuZero builds a search tree inside a learned state.
MuZero · representation h, dynamics g, prediction f. Rewards belong to transitions; policies and values belong to states.

g.title: MuZero builds a search tree inside a learned state.
g.desc: MuZero · representation h, dynamics g, prediction f. Rewards belong to transitions; policies and values belong to states. Representation h maps the observation history to a root state. This state is trained for search-relevant predictions. Each hypothetical action goes through g, producing the next hidden state and reward. Function f supplies policy priors and a value at that state. Search repeatedly selects, expands, and backs up returns. Root visits determine the search policy used to choose the real action. Branches show different hypothetical actions with shared g and f parameters. Joint training unrolls real replay actions and fits policy, value, and reward targets. No observation reconstruction objective is required.

text.tspan: Training targets: search policy π, return z, observed reward u
Branches show different hypothetical actions with shared g and f parameters. Joint training unrolls real replay actions and
fits policy, value, and reward targets. No observation reconstruction objective is required.
TD-MPC2 optimizes a short sequence of actions.
TD-MPC2 · continuous control. Candidate trajectories are scored using rewards and a terminal value estimate.

g.title: TD-MPC2 optimizes a short sequence of actions.
g.desc: TD-MPC2 · continuous control. Candidate trajectories are scored using rewards and a terminal value estimate. Encode the current observation. The policy contributes action-sequence proposals alongside sampled candidates. The latent dynamics model rolls each sequence forward. Predicted rewards and an ensemble-based terminal Q estimate determine its score. Weighted elites update the sampling distribution. Refine again, then execute only the first action and replan after observing the environment. Curves illustrate candidates, not benchmark results. Training combines latent consistency, reward regression, and bootstrapped Q objectives. Task embeddings and implementation-specific value aggregation are omitted.

text.tspan: J = Σₖ γᵏ r(zk,ak) + γᴴ Q(zH,π(zH))
